metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: a prompt-cache and context row with compaction controls, and a usage-limits row.

plugins.name: cache-meter
plugins.description: Prompt-cache hit rate and context fill in one row above the prompt, with a switchable auto-compact threshold and Compact and Clear buttons.

plugins.name: usage-limits
plugins.description: One row above the prompt: how much of the 5-hour and weekly usage limits is used, in percent, with the time until each resets.
